meta.name: Quantum Explorer
meta.longDescription: Quantum Explorer tracks Dogecoin post-quantum transaction signals in realtime from pure P2P mempool gossip and confirms transaction visibility through SPV logs. Public users can search by Dogecoin address, txid, block height/hash text, and see latest PQ activity with pending/confirmed + PQ-validity indicators. Admin controls are token-gated on the same web port via /admin/<TOKEN> and /api/admin/<TOKEN>/* for mempool/SPV start-stop and checkpoint metadata. The admin checkpoint (height/hash/timestamp) is reference metadata for operators; libdogecoin spvnode is started like pq-wallet with -w/-h and -b scan last. Block hashes from explorers (SoChain, etc.) use the normal Dogecoin block ID hex — not a different endianness for the same height. Optional QE_SPV_WATCH_ADDRESS sets spvnode -a like pq-wallet. Default checkpoint example: block 6150000, hash 9e8f55907f17dc4870cdc9e6ea75236782190c13c10a8126baea3b1da94593c5, timestamp 2026-04-03T03:16:25Z.

sections.name: Web
sections.description: HTTP port is inside the container; open the URL and host port Dogebox shows for this pup (not always :33666 on the host). Strict PQ verification prefers raw tx from P2P when peers relay full tx messages; optional URL below is an HTTP fallback.

fields.name: QE_EXPLORER_TX_API
fields.label: Optional: tx API URL with {txid} returning JSON containing raw tx hex (fallback if P2P did not deliver full tx)

sections.name: SPV (libdogecoin)
sections.description: spvnode is invoked with -f 0 -c -l, wallet and headers under storage, then -b scan last. Set a mainnet/testnet P2PKH address if your build expects -a for full block scan (pq-wallet always passes -a).

sections.name: Backoffice Token
sections.description: Token used in URL path to access admin UI/API on same port.

permissionGroups.name: Quantum Explorer HTTP
